indication.text: SCENESSE is indicated to increase pain free light exposure in adult patients with a history of phototoxic reactions from erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP).

citations.quote: SCENESSE® is indicated to increase pain free light exposure in adult patients with a history of phototoxic reactions from erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP).

target_moa.text: Afamelanotide is an alpha-melanocyte stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH) analogue that acts as a melanocortin-1 receptor (MC1R) agonist, stimulating melanogenesis (eumelanin), which provides photoprotection by absorbing and scattering light.

citations.quote: Afamelanotide is an agonist of the melanocortin-1 receptor (MC1-R). It is a 13 amino acid synthetic peptide and a structural analogue of the endogenous hormone \alpha-melanocyte stimulating hormone (\alpha-MSH).

The proposed mechanism of action suggests that afamelanotide binds to MC1R and activates the synthesis of eumelanin, which provides photoprotection through absorbing and scattering visible and UV light and decreasing free radicals and reactive oxygen species.

modality.text: Peptide (13-amino acid synthetic peptide analogue of alpha-MSH), a new molecular entity.

citations.quote: Afamelanotide is a 13-amino acid linear peptide synthesized and isolated as its acetate salt and has been classified as a new molecular entity.
